```{=html}
<div class="mlsp-game-container" role="region" aria-label="Checkpoint Roulette mini-game">
  <canvas id="mlsp-canvas" class="mlsp-game-canvas" width="680" height="460"></canvas>
  <div class="mlsp-game-hud">
    <span class="mlsp-score">progress <span id="mlsp-score">0</span>%</span>
    <span>hold <kbd>Space</kbd> to train · release to save · 60 seconds</span>
    <button type="button" id="mlsp-train-control" class="mlsp-train-control" aria-label="Hold to train; release to write a checkpoint">Hold to train</button>
    <button type="button" class="mlsp-fullscreen-btn" onclick="this.closest('.mlsp-game-container').requestFullscreen()" title="Full Screen" aria-label="Full Screen">⛶</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="mlsp-aha-slot"></div>

<script>
(function bootCheckpoint(){
  function tryBoot() {
    if (!window.MLSP || !MLSP.games || !MLSP.games.checkpoint) return setTimeout(tryBoot, 30);
    var canvas = document.getElementById("mlsp-canvas");
    var $score = document.getElementById("mlsp-score");
    var ahaSlot = document.getElementById("mlsp-aha-slot");
    var pendingResult = null;
    var resolvedApi = null;

    Promise.resolve(MLSP.games.checkpoint(canvas, {
      controlButton: document.getElementById("mlsp-train-control"),
      onScoreChange: function(s) { $score.textContent = s.score; },
      onGameOver: function(result) {
        if (resolvedApi) attachAha(resolvedApi, result);
        else pendingResult = result;
      },
      onRetry: function() { window.location.reload(); }
    })).then(function(api) {
      resolvedApi = api;
      if (pendingResult) attachAha(api, pendingResult);
    });

    function attachAha(api, result) {
      var outcome = result.won ? "Training complete. " : "Time expired. ";
      MLSP.showAhaCard(ahaSlot, api.ahaLabel, outcome + api.ahaText, api.ahaLink);
    }
  }
  tryBoot();
})();
</script>
```

## How to play

Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or tap the game to start. Hold <kbd>Space</kbd> or the **Hold to train** button to advance. Release to write a checkpoint, which pauses training for 1.1 seconds. A green marker shows the last completed checkpoint. If a node fails while you are training or writing, progress returns to that marker. Reach 100% within 60 seconds. Press <kbd>R</kbd> or tap the canvas to retry.

## The Systems Concept

At large scale, hardware failures are inevitable. Frequent checkpoints limit lost work, but writing them consumes I/O bandwidth and pauses training. A checkpoint only protects work after its write completes. The game compresses this tradeoff into a one-minute scheduling decision.
